note: First-floor parlour of the second pronouns (cartoon style): cream walls, cherry-red lower panels, blue patterned rug. Landmark: the tall standing oval mirror where the man shaves himself (se). Back row: vous (butler bowing to an elderly couple), on (girl switching on a tall lamp), elle (girl ringing a brass bell), se. Front row (the painter stands well to the right of the shaving man so the two never overlap): nous (two friends sharing one noodle), te (girl holding out a teddy), toi (boy with a toy horse pointing at you), lui-même (painting his own self-portrait). Pronouns have no gender here (divider null). The red curtain nook in the back right corner zooms in on the someone/each-one pronouns. The teal door on the left goes back to the big-numbers room; the lime door on the right goes on to the first prepositions room.
